readerCopy.headline: Try the different way.
readerCopy.body:
A new tool, route, schedule, or contact can solve a problem you had started treating as permanent. The change does not need to be dramatic. One different meeting day, one new system, or one person taking a different part of the work may be enough to show you another way.

Jupiter sextile Uranus rewards curiosity with evidence. Change one variable and see what actually gets easier. You can keep the experiment if it helps and leave it behind if it creates more maintenance than it removes.
doNotAssume: Do not assume a major life change, new technology, freedom, or that the experimental option is better.
